human_clarification: 以用户手动运行evaluate.py的截图所列整套指标评价优化成效。
target_units: absolute percentage points; not relative percent
target_interpretation: At least one relevant proportional classification metric from evaluate.py at least +1.5pp versus unchanged fixed B0; report all metrics, seeds, conditional uncertainty, tradeoffs and cumulative controls.
checkpoint_selection_unchanged: original earliest maximum validation macroF1; no posthoc test-selected epoch
existing_test_role: authorized adaptive internal development; conditional CI unadjusted for model/metric selection
network_design_target: original 2-3 complementary network designs with cumulative/drop-one/mature controls; no new per-component1.5 gate
decision: re-audit existing complete evidence across all metrics before excluding prior candidates or launching additional formal training
patient_equal_accuracy: supplementary historical diagnostic only; absent from evaluate.py; not eligible as final performance metric
cost_metrics: Params/MACs/FLOPs/FPS separate; not classification performance target
coefficient_metrics: Screenshot includes Kappa/MCC; report and assess coefficient changes with proper units; do not disguise coefficient+0.015 as classification+1.5pp.
non_displayed_diagnostics: Patient-equal accuracy absent; NPV/perclassAUPR and weighted precision/recall computed by function but absent from screenshot stay supplementary, not substituted for displayed completion metrics.

screenshot.role: metric display reference only; not a replacement baseline or test cohort
